other_conditions: The applicant must be registered under the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)
The registered worker must have at least one year of regular membership
The worker must have worked for a minimum of 90 days as a building and other construction worker during the preceding twelve months
The worker must have paid up‑to‑date contributions
Benefit is payable up to the marriage of three daughters only
The applicant must submit all required documents within one year after the marriage
The applicant must not have availed similar assistance from any other government department/board/corporation
The worker must produce a work‑experience certificate duly verified by the prescribed authorities
The worker must upload the marriage certificate of the daughter
The worker must submit the undertaking prescribed by the Board
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance of ₹51,000 per daughter (up to three daughters) plus an additional ₹50,000, for a total benefit of up to ₹1,01,000 per beneficiary.
